longBusinessSummary: Peraso Inc., a fabless semiconductor company, develops, markets, and sells semiconductor devices and antenna modules in Europe, North America, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers millimeter wavelength (mmWave) integrated circuits (ICs), including baseband IC, various variations of mmWave radio frequency, ICs, and associated antenna technology; and mmWave antenna modules for license-free 60 gigahertz (GHz) applications. Its mmWave products are used for various applications comprising multi-gigabit point-to-point wireless links with a range of up to 25 kilometers and operating in the 60 GHz frequency band; multi-gigabit point-to-multi-point links in the 60 GHz frequency band used to provide fixed wireless access (FWA) services; FWA in the 5G operating bands from 24 GHz to 43 GHz to provide multi-gigabit capability and low latency connections; military communications;
